text: The Patriots head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football at 8:15 PM ET facing an injury situation that's become increasingly complicated, with starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and Ben Brown (knee) ruled out, joined by cornerbacks Carlton Davis III (neck) and Karon Prunty (hamstring), plus cornerback Channing Canada (hamstring) also unavailable—and now wide receiver Romeo Doubs (shoulder) has been placed on injured reserve, further thinning an already depleted roster. The matchup pits Drake Maye against Caleb Williams in what amounts to a reunion of sorts, as the two quarterbacks have known each other for years, were part of the same draft class, and attended the same football camps growing up. Running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to do all the little things for the Patriots and is on the cusp of reaching 100 carries for the sixth straight season, a testament to his consistent workhorse role in the offense. Expert predictions and betting analysis are circulating ahead of the divisional tilt, with plenty of prop plays and odds available for those looking to wager on Thursday's primetime showdown in the Windy City.
